'''James Zajic die die die''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[James Zajic]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-23976">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23976 die die die], DeckTech (James "dabora" Zajic, 16 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23976/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23976/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009091256/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23976/ Wayback Machine].</ref> The published list has 58 cards.

* '''Player:''' [[James Zajic]]
* '''Published:''' 16 June 2002 (DeckTech)

* '''Strategy:''' to drain opponet and tkae out vader.
